extracted.intended_audience: researchers conducting literature searches on reporting guidelines, authors of commentary on reporting/agreement studies, and open-science consumers of OSF registrations
extracted.subtask_description: An Open Science Framework registration describing a Scopus literature search (conducted Feb 28, 2026) to collect data on publication trends of review/validation studies and citation counts for PRISMA and GRRAS guidelines. The registration provides metadata and a brief protocol for a supplemental figure used in a commentary manuscript.
